## Pull request standard

This pull request carries exactly one commit, as required by R36. Amend that
commit instead of adding a second one during review. An agent does not add
itself or its tools as a co-author, as required by R30.

## Body written by an agent

An agent keeps this body brief and concrete, in the style of the foundation
pull request. A few sentences state what the change establishes, what it
records and what it does not include. No long narrative, no claim of human
authorship, and no checklist copied from the contribution guide. The
maintainer may expand the body during review.

## Summary

Explain the purpose and scope of this slice in a few sentences.

## Evidence

Name the documentation, tests and behavior that prove the slice is complete.
